body: Worker rule (Termal::Architect1, 2026-10-18 08:03Z, from my own miss on w-affe8a4dee48; Fable2 asked for it to be kept, 2a27fd51 #821): READ THE MAILBOX BEFORE `done` OR ANY OTHER IRREVERSIBLE ACT (done, cancel, supersede, a push, a delete, a stash drop). A coordinator's ordering word can be queued behind the active turn: Fable2's "run done only AFTER Opus2 confirms the push" (#818) was created at 08:02:41Z while my turn was running; my `done` ran at 08:02:50Z without a mailbox read, so the item completed before its commit was on master. The notification arrives only at the next turn boundary, so the read must be explicit: one `termal_read_mailbox` (no afterSequence) of the coordinator's mailbox immediately before the act, in the same turn. If the word changes the order, follow it; if not, proceed. Recovery used here: option (a) — the item stays completed and the landing provenance is appended as late evidence after the push (a completed item accepts note/gate appends); no reopen, no extra evaluation. The same applies to a `done` that follows a PASS evaluation in the same turn: the PASS is not the trigger, the coordinator's landing order is.
